description: This Java source file defines the LoanDisbursementValidator class, which contains validation logic for loan disbursal operations within the Fineract project. It includes methods to compare disbursed amounts against approved or proposed totals, validate disbursement dates, and enforce business constraints related to loan disbursal amounts and timing.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementValidator
classes.description: A final class responsible for validating loan disbursement details such as disbursed amount and disbursement date.

methods.name: compareDisbursedToApprovedOrProposedPrincipal
methods.description: Validates that the disbursed amount does not exceed the approved principal or proposed amount considering various loan product settings.

methods.name: validateOverMaximumAmount
methods.description: Checks if the total disbursed amount exceeds the maximum allowed, throwing an exception if so.

methods.name: validateDisburseDate
methods.description: Ensures the disbursal date is not after the expected first repayment date or in the future.
